title: ashemag/human-atlas
why_read: An open-source interactive 3D anatomy explorer built on a large public mesh dataset, technically interesting for its 3D web rendering and dataset curation work.
analysis: This project renders 2,234 selectable anatomical meshes from the BodyParts3D dataset in-browser with layered systems, search, and exploded views, which is a solid technical achievement in 3D web rendering, performance optimization, and UX design for large mesh datasets. It's a good example of applying WebGL/Three.js-style rendering to a large structured dataset for an educational/medical use case. Interest is moderate-high for engineers curious about performant 3D visualization in the browser.
